verdict.rationale: Luma's own materials document reference-driven generation. They list image-to-video and video-to-video with character reference [luma-docs-5]. Ray can apply motion from a source video to new subjects, scenes, or styles [luma-docs-9], and Modify Video reshapes existing footage [luma-docs-7]. Style references are carried into every generated asset [luma-docs-22]. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how style references are supplied and how faithfully style is transferred, plus any hands-on or independent corroboration of style-matched output quality.
